data.name: BIO SIN
data.detailed_description:
The world has ended.

And yet, not even that was enough to erase the horrors of runaway bioengineering: like shards of biological shrapnel, their effects haunt the children of the Armageddon to this very day.
With the knowledge that any day can be their last as men before losing themselves to a sickness they cannot predict nor resist, today's survivors live like wolves, imposing their will on the world through the law of the strongest, no future in sight, only a brutal but honest way of life.
But someone, somewhere, yearns for an existence greater than this primitive state of being, for to them men weren't made to live like brutes but to pursue virtue.
Let the chips fall where they may or catch their fall: the rights and duties of the Old World no longer applying, the only thing you need to realize your vision is your will.

Key Features:

  • Delve into the depths of the broken world the Armageddon left behind, explore the treacherous Santa Regina wasteland through a set of handcrafted levels;

  • Create your very own custom character, with a variety of races and apparel to choose from;

  • Battle Apolidea's fearsome foes, from merciless bandits to runaway bioengineering's most abominable spawns;

  • Increase your odds of survival by taking full advantage of Apolidea's arsenal: pistols, shotguns, assault rifles... There's no shortage of variety to dispense death;

  • Meet the people of Apolidea, make friends and enemies among the few saints and many sinners of the wastes.

data.short_description: The year is 2102. 49 years ago the world was cleansed in nuclear fire at the height of its decadence. It's a brutal place but now, at long last, an honest one. Create your character and venture into the ruins of this once formidable nation in this unforgiving post-apocalyptic dungeon crawler.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9750H @2.60GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These are the specs of the weakest machine in our possession we ran BIO SIN on. It might be possible to go lower but we cannot guarantee that

content_descriptors.notes:
Bio Sin portrays a world which has reverted back to a more primitive state in the aftermath of the Armageddon, one in which the rights and duties of the one we live in no longer apply.
Therefore, there will be depictions of liberal use of violence, alcohol and drug abuse, suicide, human trafficking and slavery, mild nudity (sex workers may wear scant clothing), full nudity (in the case of certain creatures, especially the Berserkers, once people who due to their sickness devolved to a state of pure savagery and who have long lost all notions of social norms).
